build_transformer_model: build a HunyuanVideoFramepackTransformer3DModel for video generation with framepack history support
create_rotary_pos_embed: create a HunyuanVideoFramepackRotaryPosEmbed module to compute 3D rotary position embeddings for video frames
create_clip_vision_projection: create a FramepackClipVisionProjection layer to project image embeddings into the transformer dimension
create_history_patch_embed: create a HunyuanVideoHistoryPatchEmbed module to project multi-scale history latents into inner dimensions
run_transformer_forward: run the HunyuanVideoFramepackTransformer3DModel forward pass with latents, timesteps, and encoder hidden states
